⚠ Landslide disaster warning area
The upper, uphill edge of this parcel falls within a designated landslide special warning area ("red zone", steep-slope collapse). The clear, level area beside the road — where a home would be built — is well away from it and outside the red zone, so the red-zone structural requirements would not be expected to apply to a building placed there. The red-zone strip can remain as forest. The whole parcel is also within a landslide warning area ("yellow zone"). Please confirm building requirements directly with the Hakuba Village Office before purchase.
